input.quote: Client is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink hereunder
input.rationale: No non-compete or field-of-use restraint binds Client anywhere in the Agreement, so the preferred position is met. Section 2(a) affirmatively preserves our freedom to acquire, develop or license competing software and services (subject only to TrueLink's IP and our confidentiality obligations), and the Client covenants in Section 8 are limited to compliance, access control, content warranties and anti-spam — none restrict the businesses we operate or the products we may buy or build. The only reference to competition is Section 8(d)'s cross-reference to a separate "Non-Competition Agreement," which operates as a limitation on TrueLink's use of Credit Data and therefore runs in our favour; we note that agreement is not attached or defined here and should be reviewed separately to confirm it imposes no restraint on Client. The licence grant's "ordinary course of its business" wording is a scope-of-licence limitation, not a restriction on our activities.
